item.title: 高性价比的迷你工作站！Minisforum 铭凡MS-01 SE 12600H迷你工作站全面评测！支持SODIMM DDR4内存，降低使用成本！
item.itunes:title: 高性价比的迷你工作站！Minisforum 铭凡MS-01 SE 12600H迷你工作站全面评测！支持SODIMM DDR4内存，降低使用成本！
item.itunes:author: jack stone
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PCv-Fx-s_bo

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解在記憶體價格飆漲趨勢下，銘凡 MS-01SE 如何透過改採 DDR4 記憶體 打造出親民實惠的高性價比迷你主機方案。
  • 全面掌握該機種驚人的內部擴充力，包含支援半高顯卡或高速網卡的 PCIe 擴充槽、三個 M.2 NVMe 插槽以及雙 USB4 介面。
  • 詳盡檢視 Intel i5-12600H 處理器在 55W 長時間負載下的壓力測試數據、散熱溫控與極致靜音的綜合表現。

摘要

平價導向的迷你工作站新選擇

在主流 DDR5 記憶體價格不斷攀升的背景下，作者老白介紹了銘凡推出的全新迷你工作站 MS-01SE。這款機種做為經典 MS-01 的衍生版本，策略性地將記憶體規格改為更親民的 SODIMM DDR4，同時移除了板載的 10G SFP+ 光口，大幅降低玩家的裝機成本。老白指出，雖然缺少了板載萬兆光口，但主機內部保留了彈性極高的 PCIe 擴充槽，使用者隨時能依個人需求外接萬兆電口、25G 甚至 50G 光口網卡，展現極高性價比。

靈活的內部結構與擴充空間

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，MS-01SE 採用沉穩的純黑金屬外殼，前面板與後面板配置了豐富的連接埠，包含雙 2.5G 網路孔、雙 USB4 與多組 USB 介面。老白特別讚許其機箱結構，使用者只需按下開關即可優雅抽出主機板，完全實現免工具拆卸。內部支援最高 3200MHz 的雙通道 DDR4 記憶體，並提供一組頻寬為 PCIe 4.0 x4 的 x16 插槽，背面散熱風扇下方則配備了三組不同速率的 M.2 NVMe SSD 介面以及 Wi-Fi 6E 無線網卡。

穩定的效能釋放與跑分表現

該機搭載了 12 核心 16 執行緒的 Intel i5-12600H 處理器，出廠預設 PL1 功耗為 55W。老白透過 AIDA64 進行 FPU 單烤壓力測試，經過長達 1 小時 07 分鐘的滿載運作，處理器始終維持在 55W 穩定釋放，核心最高溫度僅 82°C，SSD 亦維持在 56°C。在實際效能方面，無論是影片轉碼測試，或是 Geekbench 與 Cinebench 等多核跑分，其成績皆能媲美 Core i7-12700H 及 AMD Ryzen 6900HX 等高階處理器，展現出充沛且穩定的運算實力。

出色的影音解碼與連線擴充

在日常娛樂與傳輸測試中，MS-01SE 能夠順暢運作《英雄聯盟》與《原神》，其 HDMI 2.0 支援 4K 60Hz 輸出，而 USB4 介面 則可超頻輸出高達 4K 160Hz 的高更新率畫面。內建的 Iris Xe 核心顯示卡亦具備優秀的 8K 60幀 AV1 硬體解碼 能力。此外，經由 iperf3 測試，板載的雙 Intel I226-V 網卡均能跑滿 2.35Gbps 頻寬，搭配 USB4 外接硬碟盒更可實現高達 3100MB/s 的傳輸極速，無線傳輸與相容性表現皆相當可靠。

綜合評價與性價比優勢

總結測試結果，老白認為 銘凡 MS-01SE 無論做為網路工作站或圖形工作站皆游刃有餘。在 25°C 室溫環境下，全開運轉的耳位噪音僅約 40 分貝，溫控與靜音水準極高。雖然割捨了原生雙萬兆光口，但藉由改採 DDR4 記憶體 顯著壓縮建置花費，再搭配優異的擴充彈性與 55W 效能釋放，完美契合預算型迷你主機愛好者的所有嚴苛需求，老白最終給予該產品「極力推薦」的高評價。

================================================

# 简介

This is cheaper DDR4 memory compared to mainstream DDR5 It is the only optimal solution under the current wave of rising memory prices. Hello everyone I am Laobai today I will introduce to you the SODIMM DDR4 memory that can be installed I like the new model of the mini workstation, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE, best. The Mingfan Mini Workstation family. is the focus of our attention. It provides more and stronger internal and external expansion interfaces and better compatibility in a very small body. There are also prices that are significantly lower than those of the same competing products. Among them, MS-01 is a pioneering classic, and its three configurations only support DDR5 memory, but the inevitable memory price boom. Manufacturers have also made changes in response. So we have MS-01SE.

Compared with the original MS-01SE version it uses DDR4 memory which reduces the cost of use At the same time it also removes the onboard 10GSFP + optical port So do people who like mini workstations care more about cheap memory or more onboard network interfaces? I probably care more about the cheap memory after all the built-in PCIe slots If you are particularly concerned about the network,. you can connect not only the 10g electrical port, but also the 25g or even 50g SFP + optical port Mingfan MS-01SE Device Intel 12th Generation Core i512600H Mobile Standard Pressure CPU 12-Core 16-Thread 80EU Intel IrisXe Core Display Dual-Channel DDR4 Memory 3200MHz, three PCIeNVMe interfaces, three-screen display output, dual 2.5g network cards and.

WiFi 6EPCIE16X expansion slots. Open it and have a look. The mainframe and all the accessories are here. Power Cord HDMI Cable Complimentary Screw Instruction This brick power supply 19 volts 9.47 amps a total of 180 watts of power Small host, pure black metal body,.

# 配件与接口

very calm Body interface front panel: power switch key headset port USB3.2A port dual USB 2.0 interface Rear panel dual USB2.0 dual 2.5g network dual USB4 HDMI 2.0 dual USB3.2A 10GBPS 19V power. Vents at top, rear, bottom The button under the USB4 interface is the chassis switch. Press it to pull out the motherboard, which is very convenient. Remove the three small screws on the fan Remove the fan Dual-channel DDR4 memory supports up to 3200 MHz Take a look at the 16GB SODIMM 3200 MHz memory module.

This area is a PCIe 16X slot, and the actual speed is PCIe 4.0X48GB bandwidth. After removing the bezel, the interface can come out from here, and you can install a suitable graphics card or 10 Gigabit optical port network card. When we turn it over, what we see is the back fan cooling the storage. Remove the three fan fixing screws and this is the fan Three NVMe interfaces, but they have. different speeds, 3.0X23.0X44.0X4 This is the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless card BIOS is a graphical interface give a good review the home page shows our 32g DDR4 memory 3200 MHz The factory default power consumption of PL1 in the BIOS is 55 watts and that of PL is 280 watts. We will conduct a comprehensive test according to this setting today.

# 稳定度与性能测试

Here you can set incoming call, self-start, Stability is one of our biggest concerns, and it took us only 45 seconds to open the AIDA64 FPU single bake stress test. The CPU power consumption has been reduced from 80 watts to 55 watts, and the overall power consumption has been reduced to 75 watts. The average CPU frequency is 3.3G Hz. We have been baking for 1 hour and 07 minutes. Power consumption of 12600H has been maintained at 55W Maximum CPU temperature at room temperature 25 ° C 82 ° NVMeSSD maximum temperature 56 ° C. Let's use Mingfan MS-01SE mini host i512600H CPU to transcode and see how the actual performance is. The final result was 14 minutes and 28 seconds totaling 868 seconds In the same class as AMD Ryzen's 6900HX6800H and Intel Core 12700H13620H CPU-Z Multi-threaded 625 8.7 Single-threaded 721.8 The multithreading performance exceeds 6900HX and 13620H.

and also exceeds 12700H which is a good performance Geekbench5 Multi-Core 10116 Single Core 1687 Multi-core performance is close to 12900HK higher than 12700H13620H and higher than AMDRyzen96900HX Geekbench 6 Multi-Core 10565 Single Core 2296 Multi-Core is in the. same class as 12900HK12700H13620H and AMDRyzen6900HX6850H Cinebench R23 Multi-Core 12927 Single Core 1964 Multi-Core performance is slightly lower than 12700H and 12900HK Cine bench 2024, multi-core, 701 single-core, 101 multi-core The result is similar to 6900HX6850H. PassMark multi-threaded 25031,.

single-threaded 3707 multi-threaded performance over 12700H12900HK, and 6900HX6850H similar On the whole, the i512600H's performance release of 55 watts for a long time is very good. Similar to 12700H13620 HAMDRyzen6900HX6850H in various tests.

# 图形性能与游戏

League of Legends: 1080p medium picture quality The average frame of the final big group battle is 120. Genshin: 1080p low picture quality Run and fight. More than 40 frames Display output HDMI 2.0 interface can output 4K60 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal,.

# 显示存储网络

and USB4 can output up to 4K144 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal The DP interface of our monitor can be overclocked to 160 Hz At this time this small host can output 4K 160 Hz 8-bit RGB display signals Video decoding capability of AMD Radeon core display which can hard decode local 8K 60 frames AV1 video YouTube 8K 60 frame AV1 video smooth playback. The original hard disk test is 7000 MB per second, reaching the best level of PCIe 4.0X4. USB4 connected to Thunderbolt hard disk box 3100 MB per second, very good performance of USB4 external storage We also tested the WiFi network card of the small host, this time the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless network card ran to 440 megabytes BPS. The above is the normal wireless performance in my WiFi 6 wireless network environment. Intel I226-V2.5G network card We also used iperf3 to. test the performance of the intranet. Whether it is a single-threaded upload and download or a multi-threaded upload and download, it runs to 2.35g and the bandwidth is full. There are no compatibility issues with these 2.5g NICs, Mingfan MS-01SE Mini Workstation is equipped with the 12th generation Core I5 CPU12600H, with a factory power consumption of 55 watts and a maximum power consumption of 106 watts during the performance release test. Maximum standby power consumption under Windows: 18.5W 180 Watt DC power supply is easy.

# 功耗散热静音

When the room temperature is 25 degrees, the standby temperature of CPU is 42 degrees, and the standby temperature of M.2 SSD is 54 degrees. The noise of this small host CPU is about 52 decibels when it is fully loaded, and about 40 decibels when it is retracted to the ear. It's quiet Mingfan MS-01SE mini workstation device i512600H Intel CPU factory 55 watts of performance release,.

# 最后总结

CPU performance is good It is similar to the performance of Intel Core CPU such as 6900HX6850H and AMDRyzen CPU 12700H13620H. It has a built-in PCIE slot with 8 gigabytes of bandwidth Whether it is configured with a single-slot half-height graphics card, a multi-Gigabit electrical port network card, or a 25G50G SFP + optical port, it can be equipped. It can meet the extreme needs of mini computer enthusiasts in an all-round way. Three NVMe ports, dual USB4 ports, dual 2.5g network cards, these other onboard interface configurations are also very suitable. The most important thing is that in the current situation of memory rising to the sky it downgrades the memory slot to DDR4 Relatively speaking it reduces the configuration cost of users which is very worthy of praise As for the disadvantage of course there is no on-board dual 10 Gigabit SFP plus optical port In this case, it is up to everyone.

to make a choice about the use of the mini workstation PCIe slot. Is it network or graphics performance? To sum up, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE Mini Workstation, whether as a network workstation or as a graphics workstation, It's configured with the I5 12600H performance, factory 55 watts of performance release, I think it's still enough for now. Multi-core performance is similar to the 6900HX12700H, with excellent. heat dissipation and silence The temperature of the full-load CPU does not exceed 82 degrees, and the full-load ear noise is 40 decibels. It is very convenient to open many interfaces of the chassis gracefully without tools.In particular, the configuration of DDR4 memory slots reduces the use cost of users. This is still an innovative product that meets the needs of mini PC enthusiasts in all aspects. It fully deserves our "highly recommended" rating. All right.

that's all for today. I'm Laobai Thank you for watching. Goodbye.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解在記憶體價格飆漲趨勢下，銘凡 MS-01SE 如何透過改採 DDR4 記憶體 打造出親民實惠的高性價比迷你主機方案。
  • 全面掌握該機種驚人的內部擴充力，包含支援半高顯卡或高速網卡的 PCIe 擴充槽、三個 M.2 NVMe 插槽以及雙 USB4 介面。
  • 詳盡檢視 Intel i5-12600H 處理器在 55W 長時間負載下的壓力測試數據、散熱溫控與極致靜音的綜合表現。

摘要

平價導向的迷你工作站新選擇

在主流 DDR5 記憶體價格不斷攀升的背景下，作者老白介紹了銘凡推出的全新迷你工作站 MS-01SE。這款機種做為經典 MS-01 的衍生版本，策略性地將記憶體規格改為更親民的 SODIMM DDR4，同時移除了板載的 10G SFP+ 光口，大幅降低玩家的裝機成本。老白指出，雖然缺少了板載萬兆光口，但主機內部保留了彈性極高的 PCIe 擴充槽，使用者隨時能依個人需求外接萬兆電口、25G 甚至 50G 光口網卡，展現極高性價比。

靈活的內部結構與擴充空間

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，MS-01SE 採用沉穩的純黑金屬外殼，前面板與後面板配置了豐富的連接埠，包含雙 2.5G 網路孔、雙 USB4 與多組 USB 介面。老白特別讚許其機箱結構，使用者只需按下開關即可優雅抽出主機板，完全實現免工具拆卸。內部支援最高 3200MHz 的雙通道 DDR4 記憶體，並提供一組頻寬為 PCIe 4.0 x4 的 x16 插槽，背面散熱風扇下方則配備了三組不同速率的 M.2 NVMe SSD 介面以及 Wi-Fi 6E 無線網卡。

穩定的效能釋放與跑分表現

該機搭載了 12 核心 16 執行緒的 Intel i5-12600H 處理器，出廠預設 PL1 功耗為 55W。老白透過 AIDA64 進行 FPU 單烤壓力測試，經過長達 1 小時 07 分鐘的滿載運作，處理器始終維持在 55W 穩定釋放，核心最高溫度僅 82°C，SSD 亦維持在 56°C。在實際效能方面，無論是影片轉碼測試，或是 Geekbench 與 Cinebench 等多核跑分，其成績皆能媲美 Core i7-12700H 及 AMD Ryzen 6900HX 等高階處理器，展現出充沛且穩定的運算實力。

出色的影音解碼與連線擴充

在日常娛樂與傳輸測試中，MS-01SE 能夠順暢運作《英雄聯盟》與《原神》，其 HDMI 2.0 支援 4K 60Hz 輸出，而 USB4 介面 則可超頻輸出高達 4K 160Hz 的高更新率畫面。內建的 Iris Xe 核心顯示卡亦具備優秀的 8K 60幀 AV1 硬體解碼 能力。此外，經由 iperf3 測試，板載的雙 Intel I226-V 網卡均能跑滿 2.35Gbps 頻寬，搭配 USB4 外接硬碟盒更可實現高達 3100MB/s 的傳輸極速，無線傳輸與相容性表現皆相當可靠。

綜合評價與性價比優勢

總結測試結果，老白認為 銘凡 MS-01SE 無論做為網路工作站或圖形工作站皆游刃有餘。在 25°C 室溫環境下，全開運轉的耳位噪音僅約 40 分貝，溫控與靜音水準極高。雖然割捨了原生雙萬兆光口，但藉由改採 DDR4 記憶體 顯著壓縮建置花費，再搭配優異的擴充彈性與 55W 效能釋放，完美契合預算型迷你主機愛好者的所有嚴苛需求，老白最終給予該產品「極力推薦」的高評價。

================================================

# 简介

This is cheaper DDR4 memory compared to mainstream DDR5 It is the only optimal solution under the current wave of rising memory prices. Hello everyone I am Laobai today I will introduce to you the SODIMM DDR4 memory that can be installed I like the new model of the mini workstation, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE, best. The Mingfan Mini Workstation family. is the focus of our attention. It provides more and stronger internal and external expansion interfaces and better compatibility in a very small body. There are also prices that are significantly lower than those of the same competing products. Among them, MS-01 is a pioneering classic, and its three configurations only support DDR5 memory, but the inevitable memory price boom. Manufacturers have also made changes in response. So we have MS-01SE.

Compared with the original MS-01SE version it uses DDR4 memory which reduces the cost of use At the same time it also removes the onboard 10GSFP + optical port So do people who like mini workstations care more about cheap memory or more onboard network interfaces? I probably care more about the cheap memory after all the built-in PCIe slots If you are particularly concerned about the network,. you can connect not only the 10g electrical port, but also the 25g or even 50g SFP + optical port Mingfan MS-01SE Device Intel 12th Generation Core i512600H Mobile Standard Pressure CPU 12-Core 16-Thread 80EU Intel IrisXe Core Display Dual-Channel DDR4 Memory 3200MHz, three PCIeNVMe interfaces, three-screen display output, dual 2.5g network cards and.

WiFi 6EPCIE16X expansion slots. Open it and have a look. The mainframe and all the accessories are here. Power Cord HDMI Cable Complimentary Screw Instruction This brick power supply 19 volts 9.47 amps a total of 180 watts of power Small host, pure black metal body,.

# 配件与接口

very calm Body interface front panel: power switch key headset port USB3.2A port dual USB 2.0 interface Rear panel dual USB2.0 dual 2.5g network dual USB4 HDMI 2.0 dual USB3.2A 10GBPS 19V power. Vents at top, rear, bottom The button under the USB4 interface is the chassis switch. Press it to pull out the motherboard, which is very convenient. Remove the three small screws on the fan Remove the fan Dual-channel DDR4 memory supports up to 3200 MHz Take a look at the 16GB SODIMM 3200 MHz memory module.

This area is a PCIe 16X slot, and the actual speed is PCIe 4.0X48GB bandwidth. After removing the bezel, the interface can come out from here, and you can install a suitable graphics card or 10 Gigabit optical port network card. When we turn it over, what we see is the back fan cooling the storage. Remove the three fan fixing screws and this is the fan Three NVMe interfaces, but they have. different speeds, 3.0X23.0X44.0X4 This is the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless card BIOS is a graphical interface give a good review the home page shows our 32g DDR4 memory 3200 MHz The factory default power consumption of PL1 in the BIOS is 55 watts and that of PL is 280 watts. We will conduct a comprehensive test according to this setting today.

# 稳定度与性能测试

Here you can set incoming call, self-start, Stability is one of our biggest concerns, and it took us only 45 seconds to open the AIDA64 FPU single bake stress test. The CPU power consumption has been reduced from 80 watts to 55 watts, and the overall power consumption has been reduced to 75 watts. The average CPU frequency is 3.3G Hz. We have been baking for 1 hour and 07 minutes. Power consumption of 12600H has been maintained at 55W Maximum CPU temperature at room temperature 25 ° C 82 ° NVMeSSD maximum temperature 56 ° C. Let's use Mingfan MS-01SE mini host i512600H CPU to transcode and see how the actual performance is. The final result was 14 minutes and 28 seconds totaling 868 seconds In the same class as AMD Ryzen's 6900HX6800H and Intel Core 12700H13620H CPU-Z Multi-threaded 625 8.7 Single-threaded 721.8 The multithreading performance exceeds 6900HX and 13620H.

and also exceeds 12700H which is a good performance Geekbench5 Multi-Core 10116 Single Core 1687 Multi-core performance is close to 12900HK higher than 12700H13620H and higher than AMDRyzen96900HX Geekbench 6 Multi-Core 10565 Single Core 2296 Multi-Core is in the. same class as 12900HK12700H13620H and AMDRyzen6900HX6850H Cinebench R23 Multi-Core 12927 Single Core 1964 Multi-Core performance is slightly lower than 12700H and 12900HK Cine bench 2024, multi-core, 701 single-core, 101 multi-core The result is similar to 6900HX6850H. PassMark multi-threaded 25031,.

single-threaded 3707 multi-threaded performance over 12700H12900HK, and 6900HX6850H similar On the whole, the i512600H's performance release of 55 watts for a long time is very good. Similar to 12700H13620 HAMDRyzen6900HX6850H in various tests.

# 图形性能与游戏

League of Legends: 1080p medium picture quality The average frame of the final big group battle is 120. Genshin: 1080p low picture quality Run and fight. More than 40 frames Display output HDMI 2.0 interface can output 4K60 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal,.

# 显示存储网络

and USB4 can output up to 4K144 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal The DP interface of our monitor can be overclocked to 160 Hz At this time this small host can output 4K 160 Hz 8-bit RGB display signals Video decoding capability of AMD Radeon core display which can hard decode local 8K 60 frames AV1 video YouTube 8K 60 frame AV1 video smooth playback. The original hard disk test is 7000 MB per second, reaching the best level of PCIe 4.0X4. USB4 connected to Thunderbolt hard disk box 3100 MB per second, very good performance of USB4 external storage We also tested the WiFi network card of the small host, this time the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless network card ran to 440 megabytes BPS. The above is the normal wireless performance in my WiFi 6 wireless network environment. Intel I226-V2.5G network card We also used iperf3 to. test the performance of the intranet. Whether it is a single-threaded upload and download or a multi-threaded upload and download, it runs to 2.35g and the bandwidth is full. There are no compatibility issues with these 2.5g NICs, Mingfan MS-01SE Mini Workstation is equipped with the 12th generation Core I5 CPU12600H, with a factory power consumption of 55 watts and a maximum power consumption of 106 watts during the performance release test. Maximum standby power consumption under Windows: 18.5W 180 Watt DC power supply is easy.

# 功耗散热静音

When the room temperature is 25 degrees, the standby temperature of CPU is 42 degrees, and the standby temperature of M.2 SSD is 54 degrees. The noise of this small host CPU is about 52 decibels when it is fully loaded, and about 40 decibels when it is retracted to the ear. It's quiet Mingfan MS-01SE mini workstation device i512600H Intel CPU factory 55 watts of performance release,.

# 最后总结

CPU performance is good It is similar to the performance of Intel Core CPU such as 6900HX6850H and AMDRyzen CPU 12700H13620H. It has a built-in PCIE slot with 8 gigabytes of bandwidth Whether it is configured with a single-slot half-height graphics card, a multi-Gigabit electrical port network card, or a 25G50G SFP + optical port, it can be equipped. It can meet the extreme needs of mini computer enthusiasts in an all-round way. Three NVMe ports, dual USB4 ports, dual 2.5g network cards, these other onboard interface configurations are also very suitable. The most important thing is that in the current situation of memory rising to the sky it downgrades the memory slot to DDR4 Relatively speaking it reduces the configuration cost of users which is very worthy of praise As for the disadvantage of course there is no on-board dual 10 Gigabit SFP plus optical port In this case, it is up to everyone.

to make a choice about the use of the mini workstation PCIe slot. Is it network or graphics performance? To sum up, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE Mini Workstation, whether as a network workstation or as a graphics workstation, It's configured with the I5 12600H performance, factory 55 watts of performance release, I think it's still enough for now. Multi-core performance is similar to the 6900HX12700H, with excellent. heat dissipation and silence The temperature of the full-load CPU does not exceed 82 degrees, and the full-load ear noise is 40 decibels. It is very convenient to open many interfaces of the chassis gracefully without tools.In particular, the configuration of DDR4 memory slots reduces the use cost of users. This is still an innovative product that meets the needs of mini PC enthusiasts in all aspects. It fully deserves our "highly recommended" rating. All right.

that's all for today. I'm Laobai Thank you for watching. Goodbye.

在主流 DDR5 記憶體價格不斷攀升的背景下，作者老白介紹了銘凡推出的全新迷你工作站 MS-01SE。這款機種做為經典 MS-01 的衍生版本，策略性地將記憶體規格改為更親民的 SODIMM DDR4，同時移除了板載的 10G SFP+ 光口，大幅降低玩家的裝機成本。老白指出，雖然缺少了板載萬兆光口，但主機內部保留了彈性極高的 PCIe 擴充槽，使用者隨時能依個人需求外接萬兆電口、25G 甚至 50G 光口網卡，展現極高性價比。

靈活的內部結構與擴充空間

在機身外觀與硬體配置上，MS-01SE 採用沉穩的純黑金屬外殼，前面板與後面板配置了豐富的連接埠，包含雙 2.5G 網路孔、雙 USB4 與多組 USB 介面。老白特別讚許其機箱結構，使用者只需按下開關即可優雅抽出主機板，完全實現免工具拆卸。內部支援最高 3200MHz 的雙通道 DDR4 記憶體，並提供一組頻寬為 PCIe 4.0 x4 的 x16 插槽，背面散熱風扇下方則配備了三組不同速率的 M.2 NVMe SSD 介面以及 Wi-Fi 6E 無線網卡。

穩定的效能釋放與跑分表現

該機搭載了 12 核心 16 執行緒的 Intel i5-12600H 處理器，出廠預設 PL1 功耗為 55W。老白透過 AIDA64 進行 FPU 單烤壓力測試，經過長達 1 小時 07 分鐘的滿載運作，處理器始終維持在 55W 穩定釋放，核心最高溫度僅 82°C，SSD 亦維持在 56°C。在實際效能方面，無論是影片轉碼測試，或是 Geekbench 與 Cinebench 等多核跑分，其成績皆能媲美 Core i7-12700H 及 AMD Ryzen 6900HX 等高階處理器，展現出充沛且穩定的運算實力。

出色的影音解碼與連線擴充

在日常娛樂與傳輸測試中，MS-01SE 能夠順暢運作《英雄聯盟》與《原神》，其 HDMI 2.0 支援 4K 60Hz 輸出，而 USB4 介面 則可超頻輸出高達 4K 160Hz 的高更新率畫面。內建的 Iris Xe 核心顯示卡亦具備優秀的 8K 60幀 AV1 硬體解碼 能力。此外，經由 iperf3 測試，板載的雙 Intel I226-V 網卡均能跑滿 2.35Gbps 頻寬，搭配 USB4 外接硬碟盒更可實現高達 3100MB/s 的傳輸極速，無線傳輸與相容性表現皆相當可靠。

綜合評價與性價比優勢

總結測試結果，老白認為 銘凡 MS-01SE 無論做為網路工作站或圖形工作站皆游刃有餘。在 25°C 室溫環境下，全開運轉的耳位噪音僅約 40 分貝，溫控與靜音水準極高。雖然割捨了原生雙萬兆光口，但藉由改採 DDR4 記憶體 顯著壓縮建置花費，再搭配優異的擴充彈性與 55W 效能釋放，完美契合預算型迷你主機愛好者的所有嚴苛需求，老白最終給予該產品「極力推薦」的高評價。

================================================

# 简介

This is cheaper DDR4 memory compared to mainstream DDR5 It is the only optimal solution under the current wave of rising memory prices. Hello everyone I am Laobai today I will introduce to you the SODIMM DDR4 memory that can be installed I like the new model of the mini workstation, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE, best. The Mingfan Mini Workstation family. is the focus of our attention. It provides more and stronger internal and external expansion interfaces and better compatibility in a very small body. There are also prices that are significantly lower than those of the same competing products. Among them, MS-01 is a pioneering classic, and its three configurations only support DDR5 memory, but the inevitable memory price boom. Manufacturers have also made changes in response. So we have MS-01SE.

Compared with the original MS-01SE version it uses DDR4 memory which reduces the cost of use At the same time it also removes the onboard 10GSFP + optical port So do people who like mini workstations care more about cheap memory or more onboard network interfaces? I probably care more about the cheap memory after all the built-in PCIe slots If you are particularly concerned about the network,. you can connect not only the 10g electrical port, but also the 25g or even 50g SFP + optical port Mingfan MS-01SE Device Intel 12th Generation Core i512600H Mobile Standard Pressure CPU 12-Core 16-Thread 80EU Intel IrisXe Core Display Dual-Channel DDR4 Memory 3200MHz, three PCIeNVMe interfaces, three-screen display output, dual 2.5g network cards and.

WiFi 6EPCIE16X expansion slots. Open it and have a look. The mainframe and all the accessories are here. Power Cord HDMI Cable Complimentary Screw Instruction This brick power supply 19 volts 9.47 amps a total of 180 watts of power Small host, pure black metal body,.

# 配件与接口

very calm Body interface front panel: power switch key headset port USB3.2A port dual USB 2.0 interface Rear panel dual USB2.0 dual 2.5g network dual USB4 HDMI 2.0 dual USB3.2A 10GBPS 19V power. Vents at top, rear, bottom The button under the USB4 interface is the chassis switch. Press it to pull out the motherboard, which is very convenient. Remove the three small screws on the fan Remove the fan Dual-channel DDR4 memory supports up to 3200 MHz Take a look at the 16GB SODIMM 3200 MHz memory module.

This area is a PCIe 16X slot, and the actual speed is PCIe 4.0X48GB bandwidth. After removing the bezel, the interface can come out from here, and you can install a suitable graphics card or 10 Gigabit optical port network card. When we turn it over, what we see is the back fan cooling the storage. Remove the three fan fixing screws and this is the fan Three NVMe interfaces, but they have. different speeds, 3.0X23.0X44.0X4 This is the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless card BIOS is a graphical interface give a good review the home page shows our 32g DDR4 memory 3200 MHz The factory default power consumption of PL1 in the BIOS is 55 watts and that of PL is 280 watts. We will conduct a comprehensive test according to this setting today.

# 稳定度与性能测试

Here you can set incoming call, self-start, Stability is one of our biggest concerns, and it took us only 45 seconds to open the AIDA64 FPU single bake stress test. The CPU power consumption has been reduced from 80 watts to 55 watts, and the overall power consumption has been reduced to 75 watts. The average CPU frequency is 3.3G Hz. We have been baking for 1 hour and 07 minutes. Power consumption of 12600H has been maintained at 55W Maximum CPU temperature at room temperature 25 ° C 82 ° NVMeSSD maximum temperature 56 ° C. Let's use Mingfan MS-01SE mini host i512600H CPU to transcode and see how the actual performance is. The final result was 14 minutes and 28 seconds totaling 868 seconds In the same class as AMD Ryzen's 6900HX6800H and Intel Core 12700H13620H CPU-Z Multi-threaded 625 8.7 Single-threaded 721.8 The multithreading performance exceeds 6900HX and 13620H.

and also exceeds 12700H which is a good performance Geekbench5 Multi-Core 10116 Single Core 1687 Multi-core performance is close to 12900HK higher than 12700H13620H and higher than AMDRyzen96900HX Geekbench 6 Multi-Core 10565 Single Core 2296 Multi-Core is in the. same class as 12900HK12700H13620H and AMDRyzen6900HX6850H Cinebench R23 Multi-Core 12927 Single Core 1964 Multi-Core performance is slightly lower than 12700H and 12900HK Cine bench 2024, multi-core, 701 single-core, 101 multi-core The result is similar to 6900HX6850H. PassMark multi-threaded 25031,.

single-threaded 3707 multi-threaded performance over 12700H12900HK, and 6900HX6850H similar On the whole, the i512600H's performance release of 55 watts for a long time is very good. Similar to 12700H13620 HAMDRyzen6900HX6850H in various tests.

# 图形性能与游戏

League of Legends: 1080p medium picture quality The average frame of the final big group battle is 120. Genshin: 1080p low picture quality Run and fight. More than 40 frames Display output HDMI 2.0 interface can output 4K60 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal,.

# 显示存储网络

and USB4 can output up to 4K144 Hz 8-bit RGB display signal The DP interface of our monitor can be overclocked to 160 Hz At this time this small host can output 4K 160 Hz 8-bit RGB display signals Video decoding capability of AMD Radeon core display which can hard decode local 8K 60 frames AV1 video YouTube 8K 60 frame AV1 video smooth playback. The original hard disk test is 7000 MB per second, reaching the best level of PCIe 4.0X4. USB4 connected to Thunderbolt hard disk box 3100 MB per second, very good performance of USB4 external storage We also tested the WiFi network card of the small host, this time the MT7902 WiFi6E wireless network card ran to 440 megabytes BPS. The above is the normal wireless performance in my WiFi 6 wireless network environment. Intel I226-V2.5G network card We also used iperf3 to. test the performance of the intranet. Whether it is a single-threaded upload and download or a multi-threaded upload and download, it runs to 2.35g and the bandwidth is full. There are no compatibility issues with these 2.5g NICs, Mingfan MS-01SE Mini Workstation is equipped with the 12th generation Core I5 CPU12600H, with a factory power consumption of 55 watts and a maximum power consumption of 106 watts during the performance release test. Maximum standby power consumption under Windows: 18.5W 180 Watt DC power supply is easy.

# 功耗散热静音

When the room temperature is 25 degrees, the standby temperature of CPU is 42 degrees, and the standby temperature of M.2 SSD is 54 degrees. The noise of this small host CPU is about 52 decibels when it is fully loaded, and about 40 decibels when it is retracted to the ear. It's quiet Mingfan MS-01SE mini workstation device i512600H Intel CPU factory 55 watts of performance release,.

# 最后总结

CPU performance is good It is similar to the performance of Intel Core CPU such as 6900HX6850H and AMDRyzen CPU 12700H13620H. It has a built-in PCIE slot with 8 gigabytes of bandwidth Whether it is configured with a single-slot half-height graphics card, a multi-Gigabit electrical port network card, or a 25G50G SFP + optical port, it can be equipped. It can meet the extreme needs of mini computer enthusiasts in an all-round way. Three NVMe ports, dual USB4 ports, dual 2.5g network cards, these other onboard interface configurations are also very suitable. The most important thing is that in the current situation of memory rising to the sky it downgrades the memory slot to DDR4 Relatively speaking it reduces the configuration cost of users which is very worthy of praise As for the disadvantage of course there is no on-board dual 10 Gigabit SFP plus optical port In this case, it is up to everyone.

to make a choice about the use of the mini workstation PCIe slot. Is it network or graphics performance? To sum up, the Ming-Fan MS-01SE Mini Workstation, whether as a network workstation or as a graphics workstation, It's configured with the I5 12600H performance, factory 55 watts of performance release, I think it's still enough for now. Multi-core performance is similar to the 6900HX12700H, with excellent. heat dissipation and silence The temperature of the full-load CPU does not exceed 82 degrees, and the full-load ear noise is 40 decibels. It is very convenient to open many interfaces of the chassis gracefully without tools.In particular, the configuration of DDR4 memory slots reduces the use cost of users. This is still an innovative product that meets the needs of mini PC enthusiasts in all aspects. It fully deserves our "highly recommended" rating. All right.

that's all for today. I'm Laobai Thank you for watching. Goodbye.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握因 AI 熱潮引發記憶體與固態硬碟價格飆漲背景下的最佳迷你主機選購策略。
  • 全面盤點從千元入門、兩千元 780M 核心顯卡旗艦到高階獨顯工作站的性價比推薦名單。
  • 深入解析各款機型的散熱設計、性能釋放水準與擴充接口優劣，助你在購物季精準避坑。

摘要

記憶體飆漲下的迷你主機市場現狀

影片中老白指出，受全球 AI 資料中心建設對 HBM 與 NVMe SSD 需求激增的影響，消費級記憶體與硬碟價格大幅飆升，導致迷你主機整體成本顯著上升。以往千元即可入手的配置如今大幅漲價，許多品牌甚至縮減或放棄了產品線。因此在當前市場環境下，購買準系統版本成為更具性價比的理性選擇。

千元內實惠低功耗機型推薦

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oxZNuGpOWJg

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握因 AI 熱潮引發記憶體與固態硬碟價格飆漲背景下的最佳迷你主機選購策略。
  • 全面盤點從千元入門、兩千元 780M 核心顯卡旗艦到高階獨顯工作站的性價比推薦名單。
  • 深入解析各款機型的散熱設計、性能釋放水準與擴充接口優劣，助你在購物季精準避坑。

摘要

記憶體飆漲下的迷你主機市場現狀

影片中老白指出，受全球 AI 資料中心建設對 HBM 與 NVMe SSD 需求激增的影響，消費級記憶體與硬碟價格大幅飆升，導致迷你主機整體成本顯著上升。以往千元即可入手的配置如今大幅漲價，許多品牌甚至縮減或放棄了產品線。因此在當前市場環境下，購買準系統版本成為更具性價比的理性選擇。

千元內實惠低功耗機型推薦

在千元以內的入門級市場中，多數廠商已逐漸退出，但仍有少數具備實用價值的選擇。老白重點推薦了售價 899 元的 G3S（N95 準系統），其具備實惠的 DDR4 記憶體支援、15 瓦性能釋放、靜音散熱與 2.5G 網口；另一款則是 879 元的 極摩客 G10（Ryzen 5 3500U），具備四核八線程、三螢幕輸出及超小體積，綜合性能超越常見的 N100 與 N200 機型。

兩千元檔位 780M 核顯旗艦推薦

針對約兩千元預算區間，老白認為配備 780M 核心顯卡 的機型是短期內最不容易過時且性價比最高的選擇。推薦名單包含具備全鋁合金機身與 Oculink 接口的 天鋇 Maco、性能釋放穩健的 銘凡 UM870 Plus、全新設計的 極摩客 K12、搭載下壓式散熱系統且價格僅 1790 元的 極夜 T2，以及散熱與性能釋放極致的 FEVM FA880 Pro。

高階擴充性與獨立顯卡迷你工作站

對於需要外接顯卡或高性能工作站需求的玩家，老白推薦了三款旗艦產品：擁有三個 PCIe 插槽與極強擴充潛力的 銘凡 MS-02 Ultra，可謂能應對未來數年折騰的頂級迷你工作站；具備雙 PCIe 4.0 插槽並支援全高雙槽短卡的 極夜 Next2，搭配補貼性價比極高；最後則是搭載 R9-8940HX 與 RTX 5060 筆電版獨顯的 ROG 9 Mini 特色版，以頂級規格、完善接口與保值性成為首發超值代表。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解由老白免費開源分享的 Mac 系統即時監控工具 MacSens，為使用者提供 iStatMenus 之外的輕量新選擇。
  • 掌握 MacSens 如何解決傳統監控軟體缺乏「峰值數據記錄」與直觀圖表的痛點，特別適合硬體效能測試愛好者。
  • 獲取 Apple Silicon（M1 至 M4 系列晶片）Mac 設備的安裝防護排除教學、實測表現細節及軟體相容性限制。

摘要

告別繁瑣工具：MacSens 的開發契機與核心定位

老白向大家介紹了他自主研發的 Mac 系統即時監控軟體MacSens。長期以來，市面上常見的iStatMenus不僅費用昂貴，在進行硬體效能測試時也因無法直觀記錄峰值數據與圖表而顯得不夠實用。為了滿足自身在測試時對關鍵數據記錄的需求，老白打造了這款免費提供給社群使用的選單列監控軟體。

直觀的三段式 UI 與強大的模組化監控功能

MacSens在選單列即時呈現 CPU 使用率、記憶體佔用與網路上下行速度。點擊展開後，完整的 UI 介面分為三大區塊：頂部列出軟硬體版本與最具特色的峰值統計範圍設定（可選擇自重設或啟動後記錄），並支援橫向與直向排列切換；中間區塊匯總了 CPU 與 GPU 核心數、記憶體與 SSD 使用量及硬體取樣間隔；底部則提供高達十四個模組的圖表監控，涵蓋 CPU 大小核即時頻率與佔用、整體功耗、溫度以及各項硬體即時曲線。

實機壓測、安裝步驟與硬體相容性限制

在實際運行Cinebench與Geekbench 6測試時，MacSens 能清楚捕捉 Apple 晶片高達 110 度的高溫耐受力與 3.5GHz 的頻率峰值。軟體安裝時若遇到 macOS 系統的未驗證開發者警告，使用者只需至「隱私權與安全性」設定中點選「仍要開啟」即可完成。老白坦言，因目前開發測試環境為M2 MacBook Air，該工具主要適用於M1 至 M4架構的 Mac，暫不支援 Intel CPU。此外，老白也分享了近期運用VibeCoding打造的即時雙語翻譯外掛與小遊戲，供有需要的使用者免費下載。

================================================

During the festival. I made some useful and interesting software for my brothers. Hello everyone,. I am Laobai, and today I. will introduce to. you the Mac system real-time monitoring software. MacSens developed by myself. Last time we made. a Google plugin for real-time bilingual translation,. which is really useful,. and I have switched to it. No more rogue software pop-up windows. begging me to upgrade Pro users. Then I looked at my menu bar. You know, this is really complicated. This is the iStatMenus. I've been using for years, and it's very expensive if. you don't install the. cracked version. And if you want to monitor the. system data of Mac in a certain period of time,. iStatMenus is actually. very difficult to use. It does not record peak graphs.

and is not intuitive. So in order to meet my own needs. I developed this MacSens system monitoring software. It is still released for free use. When you come to download,. it would be great to click on. a follow or like collection by the way. Thank you. Our software is. a menu bar application,. so I added a menu. bar display in the latest version. Some key real-time data is shown. Before opening. our complete monitoring interface,. we can see some main data. This is the icon for the menu bar of our MacSens software. CPU real-time usage. memory real-time usage. network upload and download real-time speed. When we click the menu bar area of MacSens,. our entire UI. monitoring interface will pop up directly. The whole monitoring UI interface is divided into three parts.

The first part is the name. and version number of our APP in the top row. And hardware and software information for our current Mac. The one on the right is the most critical function of the software. One of the purposes of making this software is to. monitor the data of our performance test. Then we need the peak data and graph. at the time of the test. Here we can choose the range where we test the peak of the data. The first option is since the last reset,. the second option is since the software started,That is,. we can click the. reset button next to. it and then start the test. You can see the system peak and. graph data for our current test. The button on the far right of the. first part is the arrangement of the system monitoring modules. At present, we arrange them vertically. You can switch back. and forth between horizontal and vertical rows by clicking this button. The second part of the UI monitoring interface. is the summary of the specific parameters. identified by our hardware.

Including the number of CPU cores,. the number of GPU cores,. the size of physical memory,. the size of the system SSD,. the usage of memory and SSD,. and the way of heat dissipation. On the far right. here is the sampling interval of our hardware parameters. The third part of the UI monitoring interface is. the monitoring of our fourteen hardware modules,. and it is a monitoring with charts,. which is clear at a glance. Let's take the vertical row as. an example. The first column is the real-time data, real-time frequency and occupancy rate. of the E and P cores of the CPU. There are also peak frequencies and memory footprint. The second column is the overall. CPU power CPU temperature CPU utilization. and the system SSD. The third column is GPU power consumption,. GPU temperature, GPU occupancy, and GPU frequency. The fourth column is other temperatures and. other power consumption without breakdown,.

as well as the speed of network upload and download. Most of the above modules have peak records. which is convenient for us to observe when doing tests. Let's run a Cinebench to see the multi-core first. Apple's CPU is much more tolerant. to. heat dissipation than x86,. with a peak of. more than 110 degrees. Multi-core frequency peak 3.5G Hz. If you look at the single core. you can run the frequency of 3.5G Hz. Single-core has always been Apple's strong point. Run the GPU test of Geekbench6 again. If you look at the GPU,. Software exit is also very simple. you can press the double finger on the menu bar. There is an option to exit. We upload the new version of the. real-time monitoring system software on the. menu bar to the network disk. The link will be. placed in the video description,. and you can download and use it at will. The MacSens installation process first decompresses.

the downloaded software into the. subdirectory after the software is decompressed,. and clicks the installation command. An unverifiable warning appears. Click Finish to close the window. Open the settings, find privacy and security,. slide down to select still open,. enter the password or fingerprint,. open the automatic installation. In the menu bar. click on our real-time monitoring MacSens. The installation is complete. Let's talk about the shortcomings of this software. first of all. because the time to write is short. and my needs are relatively narrow. It is mainly used to test peak recording. so its function is relatively single. Another drawback is. that the current programming. test environment is an M2 MacBook Air,. so it may not. work on Macs with Intel CPUs. Then, it has not been tested.

and recoded on models with three CPU cores. after M5,. so it may only be suitable. for M1 to M4 CPUs. If you find any bugs. you can leave me a message. Recently we have created several pieces of. software using VibeCoding,. with real-time bilingual translation plug-ins and. real-time monitoring of this Mac system. There is also a small game of Nu Ting HD jacking off. There is also this 3D Bomber mini-game,. in which the real-time bilingual translation plug-in. is universal and can be used for both Windows and Mac. It's for Google Chrome. The other three are Mac. apps that use Swift's. shell WKWebView to encapsulate them. If you need a real-time bilingual translation plug-in,. or use the Mac to play small. games to relax,. or monitor the Mac system in real time,. You can download them. I will put all the updates.

in the latest video description every time. All right, that's all for today. I'm Laobai. Thank you for watching. Welcome to like, follow,. Goodbye.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解由老白免費開源分享的 Mac 系統即時監控工具 MacSens，為使用者提供 iStatMenus 之外的輕量新選擇。
  • 掌握 MacSens 如何解決傳統監控軟體缺乏「峰值數據記錄」與直觀圖表的痛點，特別適合硬體效能測試愛好者。
  • 獲取 Apple Silicon（M1 至 M4 系列晶片）Mac 設備的安裝防護排除教學、實測表現細節及軟體相容性限制。

摘要

告別繁瑣工具：MacSens 的開發契機與核心定位

老白向大家介紹了他自主研發的 Mac 系統即時監控軟體MacSens。長期以來，市面上常見的iStatMenus不僅費用昂貴，在進行硬體效能測試時也因無法直觀記錄峰值數據與圖表而顯得不夠實用。為了滿足自身在測試時對關鍵數據記錄的需求，老白打造了這款免費提供給社群使用的選單列監控軟體。

直觀的三段式 UI 與強大的模組化監控功能

MacSens在選單列即時呈現 CPU 使用率、記憶體佔用與網路上下行速度。點擊展開後，完整的 UI 介面分為三大區塊：頂部列出軟硬體版本與最具特色的峰值統計範圍設定（可選擇自重設或啟動後記錄），並支援橫向與直向排列切換；中間區塊匯總了 CPU 與 GPU 核心數、記憶體與 SSD 使用量及硬體取樣間隔；底部則提供高達十四個模組的圖表監控，涵蓋 CPU 大小核即時頻率與佔用、整體功耗、溫度以及各項硬體即時曲線。

實機壓測、安裝步驟與硬體相容性限制

在實際運行Cinebench與Geekbench 6測試時，MacSens 能清楚捕捉 Apple 晶片高達 110 度的高溫耐受力與 3.5GHz 的頻率峰值。軟體安裝時若遇到 macOS 系統的未驗證開發者警告，使用者只需至「隱私權與安全性」設定中點選「仍要開啟」即可完成。老白坦言，因目前開發測試環境為M2 MacBook Air，該工具主要適用於M1 至 M4架構的 Mac，暫不支援 Intel CPU。此外，老白也分享了近期運用VibeCoding打造的即時雙語翻譯外掛與小遊戲，供有需要的使用者免費下載。

================================================

During the festival. I made some useful and interesting software for my brothers. Hello everyone,. I am Laobai, and today I. will introduce to. you the Mac system real-time monitoring software. MacSens developed by myself. Last time we made. a Google plugin for real-time bilingual translation,. which is really useful,. and I have switched to it. No more rogue software pop-up windows. begging me to upgrade Pro users. Then I looked at my menu bar. You know, this is really complicated. This is the iStatMenus. I've been using for years, and it's very expensive if. you don't install the. cracked version. And if you want to monitor the. system data of Mac in a certain period of time,. iStatMenus is actually. very difficult to use. It does not record peak graphs.

and is not intuitive. So in order to meet my own needs. I developed this MacSens system monitoring software. It is still released for free use. When you come to download,. it would be great to click on. a follow or like collection by the way. Thank you. Our software is. a menu bar application,. so I added a menu. bar display in the latest version. Some key real-time data is shown. Before opening. our complete monitoring interface,. we can see some main data. This is the icon for the menu bar of our MacSens software. CPU real-time usage. memory real-time usage. network upload and download real-time speed. When we click the menu bar area of MacSens,. our entire UI. monitoring interface will pop up directly. The whole monitoring UI interface is divided into three parts.

The first part is the name. and version number of our APP in the top row. And hardware and software information for our current Mac. The one on the right is the most critical function of the software. One of the purposes of making this software is to. monitor the data of our performance test. Then we need the peak data and graph. at the time of the test. Here we can choose the range where we test the peak of the data. The first option is since the last reset,. the second option is since the software started,That is,. we can click the. reset button next to. it and then start the test. You can see the system peak and. graph data for our current test. The button on the far right of the. first part is the arrangement of the system monitoring modules. At present, we arrange them vertically. You can switch back. and forth between horizontal and vertical rows by clicking this button. The second part of the UI monitoring interface. is the summary of the specific parameters. identified by our hardware.

Including the number of CPU cores,. the number of GPU cores,. the size of physical memory,. the size of the system SSD,. the usage of memory and SSD,. and the way of heat dissipation. On the far right. here is the sampling interval of our hardware parameters. The third part of the UI monitoring interface is. the monitoring of our fourteen hardware modules,. and it is a monitoring with charts,. which is clear at a glance. Let's take the vertical row as. an example. The first column is the real-time data, real-time frequency and occupancy rate. of the E and P cores of the CPU. There are also peak frequencies and memory footprint. The second column is the overall. CPU power CPU temperature CPU utilization. and the system SSD. The third column is GPU power consumption,. GPU temperature, GPU occupancy, and GPU frequency. The fourth column is other temperatures and. other power consumption without breakdown,.

as well as the speed of network upload and download. Most of the above modules have peak records. which is convenient for us to observe when doing tests. Let's run a Cinebench to see the multi-core first. Apple's CPU is much more tolerant. to. heat dissipation than x86,. with a peak of. more than 110 degrees. Multi-core frequency peak 3.5G Hz. If you look at the single core. you can run the frequency of 3.5G Hz. Single-core has always been Apple's strong point. Run the GPU test of Geekbench6 again. If you look at the GPU,. Software exit is also very simple. you can press the double finger on the menu bar. There is an option to exit. We upload the new version of the. real-time monitoring system software on the. menu bar to the network disk. The link will be. placed in the video description,. and you can download and use it at will. The MacSens installation process first decompresses.

the downloaded software into the. subdirectory after the software is decompressed,. and clicks the installation command. An unverifiable warning appears. Click Finish to close the window. Open the settings, find privacy and security,. slide down to select still open,. enter the password or fingerprint,. open the automatic installation. In the menu bar. click on our real-time monitoring MacSens. The installation is complete. Let's talk about the shortcomings of this software. first of all. because the time to write is short. and my needs are relatively narrow. It is mainly used to test peak recording. so its function is relatively single. Another drawback is. that the current programming. test environment is an M2 MacBook Air,. so it may not. work on Macs with Intel CPUs. Then, it has not been tested.

and recoded on models with three CPU cores. after M5,. so it may only be suitable. for M1 to M4 CPUs. If you find any bugs. you can leave me a message. Recently we have created several pieces of. software using VibeCoding,. with real-time bilingual translation plug-ins and. real-time monitoring of this Mac system. There is also a small game of Nu Ting HD jacking off. There is also this 3D Bomber mini-game,. in which the real-time bilingual translation plug-in. is universal and can be used for both Windows and Mac. It's for Google Chrome. The other three are Mac. apps that use Swift's. shell WKWebView to encapsulate them. If you need a real-time bilingual translation plug-in,. or use the Mac to play small. games to relax,. or monitor the Mac system in real time,. You can download them. I will put all the updates.

in the latest video description every time. All right, that's all for today. I'm Laobai. Thank you for watching. Welcome to like, follow,. Goodbye.

=============

item.content:encoded:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yhHyiYkZI3M

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解由老白免費開源分享的 Mac 系統即時監控工具 MacSens，為使用者提供 iStatMenus 之外的輕量新選擇。
  • 掌握 MacSens 如何解決傳統監控軟體缺乏「峰值數據記錄」與直觀圖表的痛點，特別適合硬體效能測試愛好者。
  • 獲取 Apple Silicon（M1 至 M4 系列晶片）Mac 設備的安裝防護排除教學、實測表現細節及軟體相容性限制。

摘要

告別繁瑣工具：MacSens 的開發契機與核心定位

老白向大家介紹了他自主研發的 Mac 系統即時監控軟體MacSens。長期以來，市面上常見的iStatMenus不僅費用昂貴，在進行硬體效能測試時也因無法直觀記錄峰值數據與圖表而顯得不夠實用。為了滿足自身在測試時對關鍵數據記錄的需求，老白打造了這款免費提供給社群使用的選單列監控軟體。

直觀的三段式 UI 與強大的模組化監控功能

MacSens在選單列即時呈現 CPU 使用率、記憶體佔用與網路上下行速度。點擊展開後，完整的 UI 介面分為三大區塊：頂部列出軟硬體版本與最具特色的峰值統計範圍設定（可選擇自重設或啟動後記錄），並支援橫向與直向排列切換；中間區塊匯總了 CPU 與 GPU 核心數、記憶體與 SSD 使用量及硬體取樣間隔；底部則提供高達十四個模組的圖表監控，涵蓋 CPU 大小核即時頻率與佔用、整體功耗、溫度以及各項硬體即時曲線。

實機壓測、安裝步驟與硬體相容性限制

在實際運行Cinebench與Geekbench 6測試時，MacSens 能清楚捕捉 Apple 晶片高達 110 度的高溫耐受力與 3.5GHz 的頻率峰值。軟體安裝時若遇到 macOS 系統的未驗證開發者警告，使用者只需至「隱私權與安全性」設定中點選「仍要開啟」即可完成。老白坦言，因目前開發測試環境為M2 MacBook Air，該工具主要適用於M1 至 M4架構的 Mac，暫不支援 Intel CPU。此外，老白也分享了近期運用VibeCoding打造的即時雙語翻譯外掛與小遊戲，供有需要的使用者免費下載。

================================================

During the festival. I made some useful and interesting software for my brothers. Hello everyone,. I am Laobai, and today I. will introduce to. you the Mac system real-time monitoring software. MacSens developed by myself. Last time we made. a Google plugin for real-time bilingual translation,. which is really useful,. and I have switched to it. No more rogue software pop-up windows. begging me to upgrade Pro users. Then I looked at my menu bar. You know, this is really complicated. This is the iStatMenus. I've been using for years, and it's very expensive if. you don't install the. cracked version. And if you want to monitor the. system data of Mac in a certain period of time,. iStatMenus is actually. very difficult to use. It does not record peak graphs.

and is not intuitive. So in order to meet my own needs. I developed this MacSens system monitoring software. It is still released for free use. When you come to download,. it would be great to click on. a follow or like collection by the way. Thank you. Our software is. a menu bar application,. so I added a menu. bar display in the latest version. Some key real-time data is shown. Before opening. our complete monitoring interface,. we can see some main data. This is the icon for the menu bar of our MacSens software. CPU real-time usage. memory real-time usage. network upload and download real-time speed. When we click the menu bar area of MacSens,. our entire UI. monitoring interface will pop up directly. The whole monitoring UI interface is divided into three parts.

The first part is the name. and version number of our APP in the top row. And hardware and software information for our current Mac. The one on the right is the most critical function of the software. One of the purposes of making this software is to. monitor the data of our performance test. Then we need the peak data and graph. at the time of the test. Here we can choose the range where we test the peak of the data. The first option is since the last reset,. the second option is since the software started,That is,. we can click the. reset button next to. it and then start the test. You can see the system peak and. graph data for our current test. The button on the far right of the. first part is the arrangement of the system monitoring modules. At present, we arrange them vertically. You can switch back. and forth between horizontal and vertical rows by clicking this button. The second part of the UI monitoring interface. is the summary of the specific parameters. identified by our hardware.

Including the number of CPU cores,. the number of GPU cores,. the size of physical memory,. the size of the system SSD,. the usage of memory and SSD,. and the way of heat dissipation. On the far right. here is the sampling interval of our hardware parameters. The third part of the UI monitoring interface is. the monitoring of our fourteen hardware modules,. and it is a monitoring with charts,. which is clear at a glance. Let's take the vertical row as. an example. The first column is the real-time data, real-time frequency and occupancy rate. of the E and P cores of the CPU. There are also peak frequencies and memory footprint. The second column is the overall. CPU power CPU temperature CPU utilization. and the system SSD. The third column is GPU power consumption,. GPU temperature, GPU occupancy, and GPU frequency. The fourth column is other temperatures and. other power consumption without breakdown,.

as well as the speed of network upload and download. Most of the above modules have peak records. which is convenient for us to observe when doing tests. Let's run a Cinebench to see the multi-core first. Apple's CPU is much more tolerant. to. heat dissipation than x86,. with a peak of. more than 110 degrees. Multi-core frequency peak 3.5G Hz. If you look at the single core. you can run the frequency of 3.5G Hz. Single-core has always been Apple's strong point. Run the GPU test of Geekbench6 again. If you look at the GPU,. Software exit is also very simple. you can press the double finger on the menu bar. There is an option to exit. We upload the new version of the. real-time monitoring system software on the. menu bar to the network disk. The link will be. placed in the video description,. and you can download and use it at will. The MacSens installation process first decompresses.

the downloaded software into the. subdirectory after the software is decompressed,. and clicks the installation command. An unverifiable warning appears. Click Finish to close the window. Open the settings, find privacy and security,. slide down to select still open,. enter the password or fingerprint,. open the automatic installation. In the menu bar. click on our real-time monitoring MacSens. The installation is complete. Let's talk about the shortcomings of this software. first of all. because the time to write is short. and my needs are relatively narrow. It is mainly used to test peak recording. so its function is relatively single. Another drawback is. that the current programming. test environment is an M2 MacBook Air,. so it may not. work on Macs with Intel CPUs. Then, it has not been tested.

and recoded on models with three CPU cores. after M5,. so it may only be suitable. for M1 to M4 CPUs. If you find any bugs. you can leave me a message. Recently we have created several pieces of. software using VibeCoding,. with real-time bilingual translation plug-ins and. real-time monitoring of this Mac system. There is also a small game of Nu Ting HD jacking off. There is also this 3D Bomber mini-game,. in which the real-time bilingual translation plug-in. is universal and can be used for both Windows and Mac. It's for Google Chrome. The other three are Mac. apps that use Swift's. shell WKWebView to encapsulate them. If you need a real-time bilingual translation plug-in,. or use the Mac to play small. games to relax,. or monitor the Mac system in real time,. You can download them. I will put all the updates.

in the latest video description every time. All right, that's all for today. I'm Laobai. Thank you for watching. Welcome to like, follow,. Goodbye.

=============

item.title: 千元DDR4内存的迷你主机！SEAVIV希未 R15 5400U迷你主机全面评测！全功能Type C接口可以PD供电和DP显示输出一线通！
item.itunes:title: 千元DDR4内存的迷你主机！SEAVIV希未 R15 5400U迷你主机全面评测！全功能Type C接口可以PD供电和DP显示输出一线通！
item.itunes:author: jack stone
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4Pyi75GQRw

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解搭載 AMD Ryzen 3 5400U 的 EAVIV 希未 R15 迷你主機在各項基準測試中的實際性能與散熱表現。
  • 解析該設備支援 全功能 Type-C 一線通、雙 2.5G 網口與雙 M.2 NVMe 等極具實用價值的擴充連接能力。
  • 針對預算有限的使用者，提供利用性價比較高的 DDR4 記憶體 打造辦公與家庭 HTPC 的客觀選購建議。

摘要

外觀設計與豐富硬體擴充

作者老白評測了這款名為 希未 R15 的迷你主機，外殼採用銀色金屬噴漆，兼顧美觀與輕量化。內部搭載 AMD Ryzen 3 5400U 處理器，支援雙通道 DDR4 3200MHz 記憶體及兩組 PCIe 3.0 x4 NVMe SSD。在連接埠方面，機身配備了包含支援 PD 供電與 DP 影像輸出的一線通 Type-C、雙 2.5G 網路卡 以及 Wi-Fi 6E 模組，提供靈活的外接與擴充性。

極限壓力測試與綜合跑分性能

在穩定性測試中，該主機在 AIDA64 FPU 單烤壓力測試下維持 28W 效能釋放，CPU 頻率穩定於 3.4GHz，滿載溫度僅約 81.2°C，散熱表現良好。各項 CPU 跑分測試如 CPU-Z、Geekbench、Cinebench 與 PassMark 顯示，其多核心成績超越了 Intel N305 與 11 代 Core i5，接近 11 代 Core i7 低壓處理器，而在英雄聯盟 1080P 中畫質測試中，大團戰平均幀數亦可保持在 80 多幀。

影音輸出、網路傳輸與功耗散熱表現

影像輸出部分支援 HDMI 2.0 及可輸出最高 4K 160Hz 10-bit RGB 的 Type-C 與 DP 介面，並具備流暢硬解 4K 60FPS VP9 格式影片的能力。實測雙 2.5G 網口皆能跑滿頻寬，待機功耗僅 8.3W，滿載整機最高功耗約 46W，隨附的 65W 電源供應器綽綽有餘。在散熱控制與靜音表現上，耳邊實測噪音僅約 42 分貝，使用體驗相當安靜。

總結與選購建議

作者指出，雖然 Ryzen 3 5400U 推出已有一段時間，但面對如今昂貴的 DDR5 記憶體價格，支援 DDR4 記憶體 的 希未 R15 反而展現出極高的性價比。憑藉穩定的 28W 性能釋放、優異的散熱靜音表現以及全功能一線通設計，對於日常辦公或作為家庭 HTPC 影音播放器來說，是一台值得推薦的中端小主機。

item.content:encoded:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b4Pyi75GQRw

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解搭載 AMD Ryzen 3 5400U 的 EAVIV 希未 R15 迷你主機在各項基準測試中的實際性能與散熱表現。
  • 解析該設備支援 全功能 Type-C 一線通、雙 2.5G 網口與雙 M.2 NVMe 等極具實用價值的擴充連接能力。
  • 針對預算有限的使用者，提供利用性價比較高的 DDR4 記憶體 打造辦公與家庭 HTPC 的客觀選購建議。

摘要

外觀設計與豐富硬體擴充

作者老白評測了這款名為 希未 R15 的迷你主機，外殼採用銀色金屬噴漆，兼顧美觀與輕量化。內部搭載 AMD Ryzen 3 5400U 處理器，支援雙通道 DDR4 3200MHz 記憶體及兩組 PCIe 3.0 x4 NVMe SSD。在連接埠方面，機身配備了包含支援 PD 供電與 DP 影像輸出的一線通 Type-C、雙 2.5G 網路卡 以及 Wi-Fi 6E 模組，提供靈活的外接與擴充性。

極限壓力測試與綜合跑分性能

在穩定性測試中，該主機在 AIDA64 FPU 單烤壓力測試下維持 28W 效能釋放，CPU 頻率穩定於 3.4GHz，滿載溫度僅約 81.2°C，散熱表現良好。各項 CPU 跑分測試如 CPU-Z、Geekbench、Cinebench 與 PassMark 顯示，其多核心成績超越了 Intel N305 與 11 代 Core i5，接近 11 代 Core i7 低壓處理器，而在英雄聯盟 1080P 中畫質測試中，大團戰平均幀數亦可保持在 80 多幀。

影音輸出、網路傳輸與功耗散熱表現

影像輸出部分支援 HDMI 2.0 及可輸出最高 4K 160Hz 10-bit RGB 的 Type-C 與 DP 介面，並具備流暢硬解 4K 60FPS VP9 格式影片的能力。實測雙 2.5G 網口皆能跑滿頻寬，待機功耗僅 8.3W，滿載整機最高功耗約 46W，隨附的 65W 電源供應器綽綽有餘。在散熱控制與靜音表現上，耳邊實測噪音僅約 42 分貝，使用體驗相當安靜。

總結與選購建議

作者指出，雖然 Ryzen 3 5400U 推出已有一段時間，但面對如今昂貴的 DDR5 記憶體價格，支援 DDR4 記憶體 的 希未 R15 反而展現出極高的性價比。憑藉穩定的 28W 性能釋放、優異的散熱靜音表現以及全功能一線通設計，對於日常辦公或作為家庭 HTPC 影音播放器來說，是一台值得推薦的中端小主機。

item.title: 2.6升独显强机畅玩4K3A游戏+部署AI编程！FEVM FN80G Ultra 7 270K Plus+RTX 5090迷你主机全面评测！支持QWEN 3.8 27B Q4 128K上下文！
item.itunes:title: 2.6升独显强机畅玩4K3A游戏+部署AI编程！FEVM FN80G Ultra 7 270K Plus+RTX 5090迷你主机全面评测！支持QWEN 3.8 27B Q4 128K上下文！
item.itunes:author: jack stone
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=upMxGrJC9hQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解一台僅2.6 公升、搭載 RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡的迷你電腦，如何兼顧遊戲與工作需求。
  • 透過多款 4K 遊戲實測、效能壓力測試與跑分，掌握它的實際表現與散熱能力。
  • 作者示範如何在 24GB 顯示記憶體中執行大型語言模型，並分享節省 VRAM 的設定技巧。
  • 影片也檢視機身內部、連接埠、網路與儲存效能，提供選購迷你工作站時的參考。

摘要

迷你機身裡的高效能配置

作者老白介紹 FVMFN80G 高效能迷你電腦，主打約2.6 公升的體積、RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡與高階處理器，並支援雙通道記憶體、雙 M.2 NVMe SSD、最高約 250W 的整機效能釋放，以及多種高速連接方式。老白也提到自己製作的雙語翻譯外掛，並表示最新版會放在新影片的說明欄。

4K 遊戲與顯示卡效能

遊戲測試涵蓋《極限競速：地平線 5》、《碧血狂殺 2》、《電馭叛客 2077》與《黑神話：悟空》。在 4K 高畫質設定下，部分遊戲可藉由 DLSS 與影格生成大幅提升流暢度；例如《電馭叛客 2077》開啟相關功能後，平均幀率達到約 228 FPS。老白認為這張RTX 5090 行動版在迷你電腦中名列前茅，足以應付多數 4K 3A 遊戲。

功耗、跑分與大型模型推論

在顯示卡與處理器雙重負載測試中，系統平均功耗約 250W；3DMark Time Spy 得分為 23,068。老白也測試大型語言模型推論，並展示以量化設定執行 Qwen 2.5 72B 模型的方式：將模型與 KV 快取盡量載入顯示記憶體，啟用 Flash Attention 與量化 KV 快取，並把螢幕接到內顯輸出，避免作業系統占用獨顯 VRAM。如此可將約 128K 的上下文模型載入 24GB VRAM，並以約每秒 40 個 token 的速度生成內容。

機身拆解與擴充能力

影片接著介紹全鋁合金機身、360W 氮化鎵電源，以及前後方的 USB、Thunderbolt、HDMI、DisplayPort 和雙網路孔。裝置提供10GbE 與 2.5GbE 有線網路、Wi-Fi 6E、六螢幕輸出能力，以及雙 PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 插槽。拆開機殼後，老白展示雙記憶體插槽、散熱板、SSD 插槽與無線網卡，並說明 BIOS 中可切換不同效能模式。

處理器、散熱與連線測試

老白以高效能模式進行長時間處理器壓力測試，處理器功耗維持在約 100W；在室溫 28°C 下連續測試一個半小時後，平均溫度約 90°C。影片也呈現轉檔、CPU-Z、Geekbench、Cinebench 與 PassMark 等測試結果，指出單核心表現尤其突出，多核心效能也位居迷你電腦前段。連線部分，HDMI、Thunderbolt、DisplayPort 與 USB-C 可輸出高更新率畫面；SSD 速度約 7000MB/s，10GbE 網路實測也接近滿速。

整體定位與結論

綜合遊戲、AI 推論、處理器跑分與連線測試，老白將這台迷你電腦定位為能兼作4K 遊戲主機與本地 AI 工作站的高效能設備。它的優勢在於體積精巧、顯示卡效能強、連接選項完整；需要留意的則是高負載下的溫度、功耗與產品規格資訊。影片最後提到，在雙重壓力測試下整機功耗可超過 322W，360W 電源仍可應付，但選購時仍應依實際使用情境評估散熱與電力需求。

================================================

The. performance of this graphics card is. among the best of all the mini PCs. we've tested; its power release is 150W. , basically allowing you to play. through 4K 3A games. First, we use FPU. to stress test the RTX 5090M mobile. version at 150W. Then adding CPU-Z for. a dual stress test, the performance. draw reaches 100W, combining for an. average output of 250W. Not bad. We ran. 3DMark tests; Time Spy scored 23,068. Fire Strike scored 51,792. Steel Nomad. scored 179.38 FPS. We turned the 3DMark. test data into a chart. With the 900GB bandwidth of. the RTX 5090 mobile version, we also. ran Llama 3 large language model tests. Still using prompt processing. The. result was 108.77 tokens per second,. ranking third overall. We ran the Qwen. 2.5 72B Q4 dense model, and similarly,. prompt processing reached 39.412 tokens. per second. the HDMI 2.1 port can output up to a 4K. 144Hz 10-bit RGB signal. The. Thunderbolt and DP ports, as well as. the Type-C port, can output up to a 4K. 144Hz 10-bit RGB signal. Intel AX211 WiFi 6E card, which reached. over 850Mbps. This is considered very. good wireless performance in my WiFi 6. network environment. Whether in single-threaded or. multi-threaded upload and download. tests, it saturated the bandwidth; this. 2.5 G card has no usability issues. We. tested the 10GbE network card using. OpenSpeedTest, hitting 9.7 G download. and 9.3 G upload, effectively maxing. out the bandwidth. an Intel Ultra 7 270K Plus CPU and an. NVIDIA RTX 5090 mobile GPU. The CPU has. a 100W power limit, while the GPU has a. 150W power limit. Based on these results, a. 360W GaN power adapter can still handle. it. At an ambient temperature of 28 °. C, the CPU idle temperature is 45 ° C,. the GPU idle temperature is 34 ° C,. and the SSD idle temperature is 41 ° C. . Under the mini PC's performance mode. with the CPU at full load, the system. noise is 53dB, and 39dB at ear level,. which is quite quiet. The F1VMFN80G is.

equipped with a 270K + CPU and an RTX. 5090 mobile GPU. The RTX 5090 Laptop. reaches 150W, and the CPU reaches 100W,. bringing the total CPU + GPU power. consumption to 250W. Looking at the. overall performance, it is a powerhouse. among mini PCs. The interface. configuration reaches a very high level. , with dual M.2 PCIe 4.0 storage,. high-refresh display output ports,. 10GbE and 2.5 G Ethernet ports, and the. 150W full-power NVIDIA RTX 5090 Laptop. GPU; it truly stands out as a top-tier. mini PC. Besides playing 4K AAA games,. through extreme optimization, we loaded. a 128K long-context, 3.8 B Q4 precision. model onto LM Studio as a local AI. coding assistant, capable of. vibercoding at 40 tokens per second.

This speed is quite fast; it’s up and. running, functional, and ready for. local programming tasks. Beyond gaming,. AI capability is another highlight of. this 5090M dedicated graphics mini PC. The chassis is only 2.6 liters, even. smaller than the 2.8-liter ROG Ally,. pushing the limits of compact design. Moreover, the design has moved away. from the previous consumer aesthetic. toward a more commercial and. professional look, enhancing its. perceived value. It is also the most. affordable in its class, with the. barebones unit around 20,000, and the. top-spec version costing only 60%of the. ROG NUC 20th Anniversary Edition. To. summarize: in Turbo mode, the CPU. delivers 100W, the GPU provides a full. 150W performance, hitting a total peak. of 250W. The overall performance is. superb, packed into a 2.6 L frame with. excellent build quality, stable. thermals, quiet operation, and a full. array of ports. The ports are highly. practical, and it performs remarkably. well in CPU processing, graphics power,. and build quality. This is a top-tier,. luxury mini PC built for AAA gaming and. AI tasks. It is perfect for those who. want a mini PC for AAA gaming titles,. as well as those with AI creation needs. . We give this 5090M dedicated graphics. mini PC our highest recommendation.

That’s all for today, I’m Lao He.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=upMxGrJC9hQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解一台僅2.6 公升、搭載 RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡的迷你電腦，如何兼顧遊戲與工作需求。
  • 透過多款 4K 遊戲實測、效能壓力測試與跑分，掌握它的實際表現與散熱能力。
  • 作者示範如何在 24GB 顯示記憶體中執行大型語言模型，並分享節省 VRAM 的設定技巧。
  • 影片也檢視機身內部、連接埠、網路與儲存效能，提供選購迷你工作站時的參考。

摘要

迷你機身裡的高效能配置

作者老白介紹 FVMFN80G 高效能迷你電腦，主打約2.6 公升的體積、RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡與高階處理器，並支援雙通道記憶體、雙 M.2 NVMe SSD、最高約 250W 的整機效能釋放，以及多種高速連接方式。老白也提到自己製作的雙語翻譯外掛，並表示最新版會放在新影片的說明欄。

4K 遊戲與顯示卡效能

遊戲測試涵蓋《極限競速：地平線 5》、《碧血狂殺 2》、《電馭叛客 2077》與《黑神話：悟空》。在 4K 高畫質設定下，部分遊戲可藉由 DLSS 與影格生成大幅提升流暢度；例如《電馭叛客 2077》開啟相關功能後，平均幀率達到約 228 FPS。老白認為這張RTX 5090 行動版在迷你電腦中名列前茅，足以應付多數 4K 3A 遊戲。

功耗、跑分與大型模型推論

在顯示卡與處理器雙重負載測試中，系統平均功耗約 250W；3DMark Time Spy 得分為 23,068。老白也測試大型語言模型推論，並展示以量化設定執行 Qwen 2.5 72B 模型的方式：將模型與 KV 快取盡量載入顯示記憶體，啟用 Flash Attention 與量化 KV 快取，並把螢幕接到內顯輸出，避免作業系統占用獨顯 VRAM。如此可將約 128K 的上下文模型載入 24GB VRAM，並以約每秒 40 個 token 的速度生成內容。

機身拆解與擴充能力

影片接著介紹全鋁合金機身、360W 氮化鎵電源，以及前後方的 USB、Thunderbolt、HDMI、DisplayPort 和雙網路孔。裝置提供10GbE 與 2.5GbE 有線網路、Wi-Fi 6E、六螢幕輸出能力，以及雙 PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 插槽。拆開機殼後，老白展示雙記憶體插槽、散熱板、SSD 插槽與無線網卡，並說明 BIOS 中可切換不同效能模式。

處理器、散熱與連線測試

老白以高效能模式進行長時間處理器壓力測試，處理器功耗維持在約 100W；在室溫 28°C 下連續測試一個半小時後，平均溫度約 90°C。影片也呈現轉檔、CPU-Z、Geekbench、Cinebench 與 PassMark 等測試結果，指出單核心表現尤其突出，多核心效能也位居迷你電腦前段。連線部分，HDMI、Thunderbolt、DisplayPort 與 USB-C 可輸出高更新率畫面；SSD 速度約 7000MB/s，10GbE 網路實測也接近滿速。

整體定位與結論

綜合遊戲、AI 推論、處理器跑分與連線測試，老白將這台迷你電腦定位為能兼作4K 遊戲主機與本地 AI 工作站的高效能設備。它的優勢在於體積精巧、顯示卡效能強、連接選項完整；需要留意的則是高負載下的溫度、功耗與產品規格資訊。影片最後提到，在雙重壓力測試下整機功耗可超過 322W，360W 電源仍可應付，但選購時仍應依實際使用情境評估散熱與電力需求。

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解一台僅2.6 公升、搭載 RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡的迷你電腦，如何兼顧遊戲與工作需求。
  • 透過多款 4K 遊戲實測、效能壓力測試與跑分，掌握它的實際表現與散熱能力。
  • 作者示範如何在 24GB 顯示記憶體中執行大型語言模型，並分享節省 VRAM 的設定技巧。
  • 影片也檢視機身內部、連接埠、網路與儲存效能，提供選購迷你工作站時的參考。

摘要

迷你機身裡的高效能配置

作者老白介紹 FVMFN80G 高效能迷你電腦，主打約2.6 公升的體積、RTX 5090 行動版顯示卡與高階處理器，並支援雙通道記憶體、雙 M.2 NVMe SSD、最高約 250W 的整機效能釋放，以及多種高速連接方式。老白也提到自己製作的雙語翻譯外掛，並表示最新版會放在新影片的說明欄。

4K 遊戲與顯示卡效能

遊戲測試涵蓋《極限競速：地平線 5》、《碧血狂殺 2》、《電馭叛客 2077》與《黑神話：悟空》。在 4K 高畫質設定下，部分遊戲可藉由 DLSS 與影格生成大幅提升流暢度；例如《電馭叛客 2077》開啟相關功能後，平均幀率達到約 228 FPS。老白認為這張RTX 5090 行動版在迷你電腦中名列前茅，足以應付多數 4K 3A 遊戲。

功耗、跑分與大型模型推論

在顯示卡與處理器雙重負載測試中，系統平均功耗約 250W；3DMark Time Spy 得分為 23,068。老白也測試大型語言模型推論，並展示以量化設定執行 Qwen 2.5 72B 模型的方式：將模型與 KV 快取盡量載入顯示記憶體，啟用 Flash Attention 與量化 KV 快取，並把螢幕接到內顯輸出，避免作業系統占用獨顯 VRAM。如此可將約 128K 的上下文模型載入 24GB VRAM，並以約每秒 40 個 token 的速度生成內容。

機身拆解與擴充能力

影片接著介紹全鋁合金機身、360W 氮化鎵電源，以及前後方的 USB、Thunderbolt、HDMI、DisplayPort 和雙網路孔。裝置提供10GbE 與 2.5GbE 有線網路、Wi-Fi 6E、六螢幕輸出能力，以及雙 PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 插槽。拆開機殼後，老白展示雙記憶體插槽、散熱板、SSD 插槽與無線網卡，並說明 BIOS 中可切換不同效能模式。

處理器、散熱與連線測試

老白以高效能模式進行長時間處理器壓力測試，處理器功耗維持在約 100W；在室溫 28°C 下連續測試一個半小時後，平均溫度約 90°C。影片也呈現轉檔、CPU-Z、Geekbench、Cinebench 與 PassMark 等測試結果，指出單核心表現尤其突出，多核心效能也位居迷你電腦前段。連線部分，HDMI、Thunderbolt、DisplayPort 與 USB-C 可輸出高更新率畫面；SSD 速度約 7000MB/s，10GbE 網路實測也接近滿速。

整體定位與結論

綜合遊戲、AI 推論、處理器跑分與連線測試，老白將這台迷你電腦定位為能兼作4K 遊戲主機與本地 AI 工作站的高效能設備。它的優勢在於體積精巧、顯示卡效能強、連接選項完整；需要留意的則是高負載下的溫度、功耗與產品規格資訊。影片最後提到，在雙重壓力測試下整機功耗可超過 322W，360W 電源仍可應付，但選購時仍應依實際使用情境評估散熱與電力需求。
